verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly claim automatic handling of forms, CAPTCHAs, and logins ('When your workflow requires a form, a CAPTCHA, or a login prompt, it's handled' and 'Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included'), directly matching the story. However, this is first-party marketing copy without independent hands-on verification or technical detail on CAPTCHA-solving mechanics/success rates, and community evidence is generic praise unrelated to this specific capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that CAPTCHA bypass works reliably, technical documentation of the anti-bot mechanism, and any real-world case study demonstrating unattended login-wall bypass.
